guarantees.claim: On negedge rst_ni, idle_q is asynchronously set to prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False; on posedge clk_i while rst_ni is high, idle_q is updated to idle_d.

assumptions.claim: idle_d must be a valid MuBi4-encoded value (i.e., one of the two legal multi-bit encodings) at each rising edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high.
assumptions.risk: A non-MuBi4 value on idle_d propagates directly to idle_q, breaking downstream multi-bit redundancy checks and potentially causing incorrect idle-state interpretation or fault detection.

uncertain_points.claim: idle_q is reset to MuBi4False, but the intended logical meaning of the idle signal is unclear: if idle_q = true indicates idle, then resetting to false means the module starts non-idle. Design intent for post-reset idle state must be confirmed.
uncertain_points.risk: If the module is expected to be idle immediately after reset, this could lead to false handshake or premature operation; if not, it may be correct but documentation is missing.
